# frozen_string_literal: true
# lib/kube_cache_client.rb
# Distributed cache client for Kubernetes service mesh
# Resolves cache node endpoints via DNS and validates TLS certificates

require 'socket'
require 'openssl'
require 'resolv'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'time'

module KubeCache
  class NodeRegistry
    ALLOWED_DOMAINS = [
      'cache-primary.prod.svc.cluster.local',
      'cache-replica.prod.svc.cluster.local',
      'cache-sentinel.prod.svc.cluster.local'
    ].freeze

    CACHE_PORT = 6380
    TLS_VERIFY_DEPTH = 3
    CONNECTION_TIMEOUT = 5

    def initialize(ca_cert_path: '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt')
      @ca_store = OpenSSL::X509::Store.new
      @ca_store.add_file(ca_cert_path) if File.exist?(ca_cert_path)
      @ca_store.set_default_paths
      @connections = {}
      @node_health = {}
      @nonce_registry = {}
    end

    def connect_to_node(service_name)
      endpoint = resolve_endpoint(service_name)
      return nil unless endpoint

      validate_and_connect(endpoint, service_name)
    end

    def get(key, service_name: 'cache-primary.prod.svc.cluster.local')
      conn = @connections[service_name] || connect_to_node(service_name)
      return nil unless conn

      send_command(conn, "GET #{sanitize_key(key)}")
    end

    def set(key, value, ttl: 300, service_name: 'cache-primary.prod.svc.cluster.local')
      conn = @connections[service_name] || connect_to_node(service_name)
      return false unless conn

      send_command(conn, "SET #{sanitize_key(key)} #{serialize_value(value)} EX #{ttl.to_i}")
    end

    private

    def resolve_endpoint(service_name)
      # Reject any hostname containing non-ASCII characters immediately
      unless service_name.to_s.ascii_only?
        log_error("Rejected non-ASCII hostname: #{service_name.inspect}")
        return nil
      end

      normalized = service_name.to_s.strip.downcase
      return nil unless domain_allowed?(normalized)

      begin
        addresses = Resolv::DNS.new.getaddresses(normalized)
        return nil if addresses.empty?
        addresses.first.to_s
      rescue Resolv::ResolvError => e
        log_error("DNS resolution failed for #{normalized}: #{e.message}")
        nil
      end
    end

    def domain_allowed?(normalized_hostname)
      # Strict byte-level comparison against allowed domains
      # No normalization or mapping - exact match only
      ALLOWED_DOMAINS.any? { |allowed| normalized_hostname == allowed }
    end

    def validate_and_connect(ip_address, service_name)
      ctx = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext.new
      ctx.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
      ctx.cert_store = @ca_store
      ctx.verify_depth = TLS_VERIFY_DEPTH
      ctx.min_version = OpenSSL::SSL::TLS1_2_VERSION

      tcp_socket = Socket.tcp(ip_address, CACHE_PORT, connect_timeout: CONNECTION_TIMEOUT)
      ssl_socket = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLSocket.new(tcp_socket, ctx)
      ssl_socket.hostname = service_name
      ssl_socket.connect
      ssl_socket.post_connection_check(service_name)

      @connections[service_name] = ssl_socket
      @node_health[service_name] = { connected_at: Time.now, ip: ip_address }
      ssl_socket
    rescue OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError, Errno::ECONNREFUSED, Errno::ETIMEDOUT => e
      log_error("TLS connection failed to #{service_name} (#{ip_address}): #{e.message}")
      tcp_socket&.close
      nil
    end

    def send_command(conn, command)
      nonce = SecureRandom.hex(16)
      framed = "#{nonce}|#{command}\r\n"
      conn.write(framed)
      response = conn.gets
      parse_response(response, nonce)
    rescue IOError, OpenSSL::SSL::SSLError => e
      log_error("Command failed: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end

    def parse_response(response, expected_nonce)
      return nil unless response
      parts = response.strip.split('|', 2)
      return nil unless parts.length == 2 && secure_nonce_match?(parts[0], expected_nonce)
      JSON.parse(parts[1]) rescue parts[1]
    end

    def secure_nonce_match?(received, expected)
      return false unless received.is_a?(String) && expected.is_a?(String)
      OpenSSL.fixed_length_secure_compare(received, expected)
    rescue ArgumentError
      # Lengths differ; treat as mismatch without leaking timing details
      false
    end

    def sanitize_key(key)
      key.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_:.\-]/, '_')[0..255]
    end

    def serialize_value(value)
      JSON.generate(value)
    end

    def log_error(message)
      $stderr.puts "[KubeCache] #{Time.now.iso8601} ERROR: #{message}"
    end
  end
end
